snippet.title: Depth of Mind(Demo) - Turn-based Roguelike
snippet.description:
Depth of Mind is a turn-based roguelite with psychological horror elements where you lead team of mental operatives.

By improving their allies, endowing them with new abilities, and collecting artifacts, the player must defeat all mental illnesses inside the human mind so that he no longer suffers.

Can you handle the agony of a man?

Play Demo on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3711100/Depth_of_Mind/
